column1: # Expected (hook, lib) inventory for core-rules/codex/hooks (spec 055 R1.5).
# One "<hook><TAB><lib>" row per library a Codex hook references. Maintained by
# hand, independent of the hooks: hook-inventory.bats compares it with the
# references it extracts, in both directions, so a reference added or dropped
# without editing this file fails. Every lib listed must resolve both in place
# (core-rules/codex/hooks/lib/, or core-rules/hooks/lib/ behind the R1.1 guard)
# and deployed (.codex/hooks/lib/ in the manifest; pi runs the payload copies in place).
